item.title: AI Code's Bad Patterns Self-Replicate: 3 Instances Become 30, Silently
item.description: AI code decay isn't about 'low quality' — it's a structurally different kind of technical debt. Models treat your codebase as a style guide and faithfully replicate whatever patterns they find, including the wrong ones. A human team catches a bad pattern at 3 instances; AI silently propagates it to 30.
